☀️ Job Creator — Demo

Vixinman Designs internal tool · client profiles → job profiles → automatic licenses, permits & compliance · Build: Piece 5.3 · Proprietary

What it does: enter a job's facts once — county, utility, products, mounting, connection type — and the tool resolves every license, permit, and compliance item that job requires, each linked to the authoritative state or source website with contact phone numbers, ready to export as a bookkeeping checklist. Requirements are data rules the office can edit, not code.

1. The client book

Client profiles hold contact info, mailing and billing addresses, and the referral source. Each client is a folder of jobs.

2. A client's folder

The client page shows their profile and every job under them. New jobs are created here.

3. Creating a job

Vixinman's real intake fields. Checking a product/service reveals its specific options — utility connection, PV mounting type, manufactured house, service type. The form enforces consistency (e.g. utility connection must match across PV, generator, and battery).

4. The payoff: requirements resolve themselves

This Taos County / KCEC grid-tie ground-mount PV + battery job automatically lists its licenses, permits, and compliance items — including Taos County's two-step permit process and KCEC's mandatory pre-screening — each with a named link to the state or source website and phone numbers. Category counts will anchor per-rule document uploads. The Export report button downloads this as a bookkeeping checklist.

5. Rules are data, not code

Every requirement is an editable row: when ‹field› matches ‹value›, the job needs ‹this›. Office staff can add rules without a developer; 93 rules are currently loaded from Vixinman's requirement matrices and the June 2026 utility/AHJ reference documents.

6. Browsable rule directory

A read-only catalog filterable by job type and variant — for looking up requirements without any risk of editing them.

Also built in

Job editing with automatic version snapshots for recordkeeping · exportable per-job requirement reports · self-upgrading database (rule updates ship as versioned batches) · 93 rules covering PV (roof/ground × grid-tie/off-grid/backup), battery banks (incl. residential/commercial), generators, mini splits, well pumps, five utilities (MSMEC, KCEC, Springer, JMEC, PNM), and four county AHJs.

Run it: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt then python app.py → http://127.0.0.1:5000 (repo: rain-solar/job-creator-app)
